rationale: This mutation eliminates the cash deficit by expanding the land ceiling from 16 to 22-24 contiguous plots across three synchronized cash-funded waves (8-10 plots by Day 5, 14-16 by Day 9, 22-24 by Day 12-14 with 10-11 hands), dedicating 18-20 plots to hyper-fertilized Strawberries and 3-4 dynamic rotation plots to lucrative Town Shop contract arbitrage. It unlocks daylight capital velocity via early micro-batch liquidations (>=2 surplus on Days 1-5) and elevates full-backpack shed drop-offs to Priority 2 immediately following in-situ harvest-and-water, feeding midday liquidations at disciplined price floors (>=0.86x base, 0.80x floor under pressure) without destructive fire-sales. Finally, it monetizes late-game idle acreage with a fast 3-day Carrot backfill between Days 22-26 and delays terminal inventory clearance until step 705+ (>=0.75x floor) to preserve full compound earnings.
